title: neuroforge-cfd: code, result files and reproduction map for "The near-wall barrier to parameter interpolation on AirfRANS is a coordinate artifact"
description: Source code, committed result files, pre-registered decision rules and the per-claim reproduction map (docs/REPRODUCE.md) for the manuscript The near-wall barrier to parameter interpolation on AirfRANS is a coordinate artifact (A. Jabbary, K. Ghanavati). Every headline number maps to a committed script and result file, and results/MANIFEST.json records seeds, environment and SHA-256 hashes. The package is CPU-first and runs end-to-end with zero downloads via a synthetic data generator; it also loads the public AirfRANS dataset.
